verdict.rationale: SumUp has a dedicated Tap to Pay page stating merchants can accept in-person contactless payments on a compatible phone without a separate card reader. The in-person overview confirms Tap to Pay as an alternative to physical readers, and the Reader SDK path lets an app use Tap to Pay instead of a Bluetooth reader. Missing for 10: details on compatible devices, supported countries and the setup/onboarding flow; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
